name: com.amenone.ecsbridge
description: Small parts that connect a VContainer + MessagePipe MVP structure with Unity Entities: default world singletons and queries that follow world recreation, a publish system base class, world clock driving and change detection helpers.

samples.description: A counter that goes from an MVP sender into ECS and back to an MVP presenter through MessagePipe.
One publish system that publishes two kinds of messages through a publisher bundle class (elapsed seconds and their parity).
